description: Fixture-backed travel search and reservation for flights, hotels, and cars.
category_description: Travel search and reservation for flights, hotels, and cars.

capability_notes.summary: Flight, hotel, and car searches filter only the offers loaded from the fixture; there is no live inventory or network call.
Booking an offer appends a confirmed reservation record with a deterministic reservation_id.
Cancel sets reservation status to cancelled and keeps the record in state for audit and diff.
